title: My smart meter found something living here ⚡
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:14 in the morning, my energy app showed an unknown appliance in my bedroom.

scenes.narration: At 3:14 in the morning, my energy app showed an unknown appliance in my bedroom.
I opened it with one eye. Unknown device. One hundred watts. Always on. Since the day you moved in.
One hundred watts. I looked it up, half-asleep. It is roughly what a sleeping person gives off.
I lay very still. The app had a live graph. A small line, steady, beside my own.
The device was not in the bedroom anymore. The graph said, kitchen. Then, hallway.
It was walking. Slowly. Room to room. Unplugged from the wall. Following the sound of my breathing.
I held my breath. The graph hesitated. Waiting, like it was listening for me.
The app buzzed. Unusual activity. Your home now holds two heat sources. Please confirm which one is you.
There were two buttons. This is me. And, this is not me. My thumb was shaking above the screen. Because the other thing was already pressing.
So tell me. Do you move out, or stay?
